close_reason: Implemented RFC 8621 As* header forms via mime-tree 0.3 typed-header API. Workspace mime-tree dep bumped 0.1->0.3; jmap-mail-server promotes mime-tree from optional to hard dep. apply_header_form now calls mime_tree::parse_header_typed for AsAddresses/AsGroupedAddresses/AsDate/AsMessageIds/AsURLs and converts via canonical jmap_mail_types::EmailAddress/EmailAddressGroup. Pinning test replaced with 5 RFC-grounded oracle tests (James Smythe address-list, RFC 5322 §3.3 sample date, RFC 5322 §3.6.4 msg-id, RFC 2369 List-Help URLs). All workspace tests green; clippy + fmt + doc clean. Commit e99c3dc.
description:
Sites: crate-jmap-mail-server/src/email.rs:306, 316, 325, 334, 343

Five RFC 8621 header forms are stubbed with eprintln('not yet implemented') + null return:
- AsAddresses (RFC 8621 §4.1.2.3.2)
- AsGroupedAddresses (§4.1.2.3.3)
- AsDate (§4.1.2.3.4)
- AsMessageIds (§4.1.2.3.5)
- AsURLs (§4.1.2.3.6)

Also pinned by integration test assertion at crate-jmap-mail-server/tests/integration.rs:6598 that panics if 'not yet implemented' property unexpectedly returns non-null.

Implementing these is required for full RFC 8621 §4 conformance. After implementation, drop the integration test pinning and remove the eprintln stubs.
title: Implement 5 As* header forms in jmap-mail-server email.rs
